short: Standard on embedding conditioning (2.4% relative MSE gain on seen speakers); behind on speaker recognition, which never separates speaker from recording session.
position: The paper changes M06 (an x-vector extractor trained on ultrasound) and M03 (that x-vector as auxiliary input to a multi-speaker spectral estimator). M03 is standard: signal-derived speaker vectors predate it, and its gain is 2.3% (development) and 2.4% (test) relative MSE (inference), with no repeated runs, on speakers seen in SSI training, as the authors state. M06 is behind on test protocol, against the best comparable work: the 0.70% held-out-speaker error pools segments from one recording session per speaker (inference), so speaker and probe placement are not separated. Nothing shows a benefit for new users.
